evidence.quote: Nightclub, gig space and events venue located on Hoxton square
Firmly established as one of Shoreditch’s leading grassroots live music venues
Home to one of Shoreditch’s favourite private karaoke rooms
covering everything from house and disco to hip hop
intimate live shows from rising stars working in genres ranging from nu jazz and soul to hip hop and electro-pop

findings.value: Club nights and DJ sets, plus live gigs in its Live Room for up-and-coming bands, and private karaoke rooms for hire. The site names no fixed weekly night, and it is closed on Sundays and Mondays.

evidence.quote: From DJ sets and club takeovers to up-and-coming bands and live shows
Our Live Room is what really sets us apart.
our karaoke hire is everything you need for an unforgettable singalong

not_found: A dated list of upcoming gigs and club nights (the what's-on and gig pages load their listings with a script; the text read had none)
notes: Named acts on the home page (not dated): Florence + The Machine, Foals and Daniel Caesar, given as past examples of the gig stage. Opening hours printed on the site: Tuesday to Thursday 5pm to 12am, Friday 5pm to 3.30am, Saturday 12pm to 3.30am (12pm to 5pm is pre-booked brunch only). The 'Live events & gigs' and club calendar could not be read, so no dated nights are listed. Pages that could not be read: none refused; colourshoxton.com/live-club/ showed no listings text.
